question: In September 2022, Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian to win the Diamond League by winning the Diamond League Final 2022 title at Zurich with a throw of______
solution:
The correct answer is __**88.44 m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra **won the **Diamond League Final 2022** title in **Zurich.**
 
• He achieved this feat by throwing the javelin at a distance of **88.44 meters.**
 
• This is a remarkable achievement as he became the first Indian to win the** Diamond League.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is a** javelin thrower from India** and has won several medals in international competitions.
 
• The **Diamond League **is an annual series of **elite track and field **events featuring the best athletes in the world.
 
• The Diamond League Final is the** last event of the season **and the winner is crowned the **Diamond League champion**.
